name: apg-scan-unresolved-directory
body: The apg_scan tool's execute resolves its scan directory as `input.directory ?? (findProjectRoot(...) ?? input.directory)` and passes it to `Bun.spawn` typed `dir as string`: when neither a project root (a directory holding apg/.trans or apg/config.json) nor `input.directory` resolves, `dir` is undefined and reaches the spawned `apg scan` argv and its cwd unchecked. Upgrade to an explicit "no project root found — pass `directory`" error returned before spawning, the next time the tool's runtime behaviour may change.
